text:
Maya: hey team -- newbie here. Trying to open the 'dev API' Grafana dashboard but most panels say 'No data'. Also I can't view errors in Sentry for the dev org. Who handles onboarding for Grafana/Sentry access? My email is maya.k@redwood.com

devex-bot: welcome! Try identity portal: https://id.redwood.com/requests for Grafana. For Sentry, infra/sre usually invites or use https://go.redwood/obs-onboard

Devon: welcome @Maya. Which dashboard and what value for `environment`/`cluster`?

Maya: dashboard is `dev-api-overview`, cluster=dev. One panel shows `Error: Panel failed to load: fetch failed 502`.

Devon: OK I'll add you to Grafana org. After you accept, refresh and set `environment=dev`. 502 likely proxy to Prometheus. If it persists, open panel > Query inspector and paste the request/response. Or run curl against datasource proxy and paste output.

Priyanka: I can invite you to Sentry. Send me your email. Note: dev org now requires org membership to view issues.

Maya: maya.k@redwood.com. I accepted Grafana and Sentry invites, panels are rendering now :tada: Any starter dashboard that has traces + error rate + flamegraph?

Devon: yes, we have a 'trace-starter-2024' template. I can clone it into your org and share. Also ping observability@redwood.com or use https://go.redwood/dashboard-request for custom dashboards.

Priyanka: tip: set timeframe to 1h and `service=api` when exploring. Happy to pair for 15 min to wire Sentry panels.

Maya: would love to pair 3pm PST today.

Devon: works for me, will DM a calendar invite.

Maya: thank you all!
